stories.title: Bombay HC nixes nod to prosecute ex-ICICI Bank chief Kochhar
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court recently issued a decisive ruling, overturning the prosecution sanction that was granted by ICICI Bank to Chanda Kochhar. Highlighting procedural flaws, the court noted that the approval from ICICI Bank lacked crucial details regarding the specific charges.
